title_en: RouteFinder: Towards Foundation Models for Vehicle Routing Problems
title_zh: RouteFinder：迈向车辆路径问题的基础模型

sentences.en: This paper introduces RouteFinder, a comprehensive foundation model framework to tackle different Vehicle Routing Problem (VRP) variants.
sentences.zh: 本文介绍了 RouteFinder，一个用于应对不同车辆路径问题（VRP）变体的综合性基础模型框架。

sentences.en: Our core idea is that a foundation model for VRPs should be able to represent variants by treating each as a subset of a generalized problem equipped with different attributes.
sentences.zh: 我们的核心思想是，面向 VRP 的基础模型应当能够表示各种变体，方法是将每个变体视为一个配备了不同属性的广义问题的子集。

sentences.en: We propose a unified VRP environment capable of efficiently handling any combination of these attributes.
sentences.zh: 我们提出了一个统一的 VRP 环境，能够高效处理这些属性的任意组合。

sentences.en: The RouteFinder model leverages a modern transformer-based encoder and global attribute embeddings to improve task representation.
sentences.zh: RouteFinder 模型利用基于现代 Transformer 的编码器与全局属性嵌入来改进任务表示。

sentences.en: Additionally, we introduce two reinforcement learning techniques to enhance multi-task performance: mixed batch training, which enables training on different variants at once, and multi-variant reward normalization to balance different reward scales.
sentences.zh: 此外，我们引入了两种强化学习技术以增强多任务性能：混合批次训练（可在同一时刻对不同变体进行训练）以及多变体奖励归一化（用于平衡不同的奖励尺度）。

sentences.en: Finally, we propose efficient adapter layers that enable fine-tuning for new variants with unseen attributes.
sentences.zh: 最后，我们提出了高效的适配器层，使得能够针对具有未见属性的新变体进行微调。

sentences.en: Extensive experiments on 48 VRP variants show RouteFinder outperforms recent state-of-the-art learning methods.
sentences.zh: 在 48 个 VRP 变体上的大量实验表明，RouteFinder 优于近期的先进学习方法。

sentences.en: Our code is publicly available at https://github.com/ai4co/routefinder.
sentences.zh: 我们的代码已在 https://github.com/ai4co/routefinder 公开提供。

title_en: RouterInterp: Understanding Superposed Specialisation in Mixture of Experts Routing
title_zh: RouterInterp：理解专家混合路由中的叠加特化现象

sentences.en: Sparse Mixture of Experts (MoE) models scale more efficiently than dense models by routing tokens to modular expert networks that are only active when relevant to the task.
sentences.zh: 稀疏专家混合（MoE）模型通过将 token 路由到仅在任务相关时才激活的模块化专家网络，实现了比稠密模型更高效的扩展。

sentences.en: A leading hypothesis for the performance of MoE models is that each expert specialises in a single, coherent domain.
sentences.zh: 关于 MoE 模型性能的一个主流假设是，每个专家都在单一、连贯的领域内特化。

sentences.en: However, interpretability efforts that assume this hypothesis have generally been unsuccessful.
sentences.zh: 然而，基于这一假设的可解释性工作通常并不成功。

sentences.en: We propose and present evidence for an alternative account that we call the *Superposed Specialisation Hypothesis* (SSH): experts specialise in a disjoint union of fine-grained features rather than one broad domain.
sentences.zh: 我们提出并论证了一种替代性解释，称之为*叠加特化假设（Superposed Specialisation Hypothesis, SSH）*：专家特化于细粒度特征的不相交并集，而非某个宽泛的领域。

sentences.en: Leveraging the SSH, we introduce *RouterInterp*, a method for interpreting expert routing that identifies Sparse Autoencoder features most predictive of routing decisions and produces unified natural language explanations.
sentences.zh: 依据 SSH，我们引入了*RouterInterp*，一种用于解释专家路由的方法，它识别出对路由决策最具预测性的稀疏自编码器（Sparse Autoencoder）特征，并生成统一的自然语言解释。

sentences.en: On gpt-oss-20b, RouterInterp explains expert routing with 57% higher detection accuracy than prior token statistics based methods.
sentences.zh: 在 gpt-oss-20b 上，RouterInterp 以比先前基于 token 统计的方法高出 57% 的检测准确率解释了专家路由。

sentences.en: This work provides a scalable method for generating concise and more accurate explanations of expert routing and increases our understanding of a previously uninterpretable component of foundation models.
sentences.zh: 本工作提供了一种可扩展的方法，用于生成关于专家路由的更简洁、更准确的解释，并加深了我们对基础模型中一个此前无法解释组件的理解。

title_en: Routing and Reasoned Evaluation with Large Language Models
title_zh: 基于大语言模型的路由与推理式评估

sentences.en: Large language models (LLMs) are increasingly used to provide automated assessment signals for evaluating model-generated outputs.
sentences.zh: 大型语言模型（LLM）越来越多地被用于为评估模型生成输出提供自动化的评估信号。

sentences.en: However, practical deployment faces three persistent challenges: heterogeneous reliability across models, substantial latency and token costs, and the absence of principled strategies for allocating evaluation resources.
sentences.zh: 然而，实际部署面临三个持续性的挑战：模型之间可靠性参差不齐、可观的延迟与 token 成本，以及缺乏分配评估资源的有原理可循的策略。

sentences.en: We introduce R$^2$Eval, a routing-aware automated assessment framework that formulates evaluation as a resource allocation and aggregation problem rather than relying on a single monolithic evaluator.
sentences.zh: 我们引入了 R$^2$Eval，一个路由感知的自动化评估框架，它将评估表述为一个资源分配与聚合问题，而非依赖单一的巨型评估器。

sentences.en: R$^2$Eval combines difficulty-aware routing with reasoned evaluation signals to dynamically select evaluator models on a per-instance basis under explicit accuracy, latency, and cost constraints.
sentences.zh: R$^2$Eval 将难度感知路由与推理式评估信号相结合，在显式的准确率、延迟与成本约束下，针对每个实例动态选择评估器模型。

sentences.en: Our study makes three contributions.
sentences.zh: 我们的研究做出了三项贡献。

sentences.en: First, we construct six difficulty-aware datasets spanning both reasoning-intensive (mathematics, logic, code) and non-reasoning (knowledge, roleplay, writing) tasks, with human-annotated reference assessments.
sentences.zh: 首先，我们构建了六个难度感知的数据集，覆盖推理密集型任务（数学、逻辑、代码）与非推理型任务（知识、角色扮演、写作），并配有由人工标注的参考评估。

sentences.en: Second, we provide a systematic empirical analysis of how reasoning traces produced by different evaluator models correlate with assessment outcomes, revealing substantial variance and systematic mismatches across difficulty regimes.
sentences.zh: 其次，我们对不同评估器模型产生的推理轨迹与评估结果之间的相关性进行了系统的实证分析，揭示了不同难度区间中显著的方差与系统性的失配。

sentences.en: Third, we develop and evaluate both offline and online routing strategies that adaptively allocate evaluation queries, achieving substantially improved accuracy–efficiency trade-offs compared to static baselines.
sentences.zh: 第三，我们开发并评估了离线与在线两种路由策略，它们能够自适应地分配评估查询，相比静态基线实现了显著改善的准确率-效率权衡。

sentences.en: Experiments across 19 language models demonstrate that R$^2$Eval significantly reduces evaluation cost and latency while maintaining close alignment with human assessments.
sentences.zh: 跨 19 个语言模型的实验表明，R$^2$Eval 在保持与人类评估紧密一致的同时，显著降低了评估成本与延迟。

sentences.en: These results highlight the importance of routing-aware automated assessment and establish R$^2$Eval as a scalable and reliable framework for large-scale model evaluation.
sentences.zh: 这些结果凸显了路由感知自动化评估的重要性，并确立了 R$^2$Eval 作为面向大规模模型评估的可扩展、可靠框架的地位。

title_en: Routing by Reaching: Composition of Pre-trained GFlowNets for Multi-Objective Generation
title_zh: 按到达路由：预训练 GFlowNet 的组合用于多目标生成

sentences.en: Generative Flow Networks (GFlowNets) learn to sample diverse candidates in proportion to a reward function, making them well-suited for scientific discovery, where exploring multiple promising solutions is crucial.
sentences.zh: 生成流网络（GFlowNets）学习按照与奖励函数成正比的方式采样多样化的候选，这使得它们非常适合科学发现，因为在此类场景中探索多个有前景的方案至关重要。

sentences.en: Further extending GFlowNets to multi-objective settings has attracted growing interest as real-world applications often involve multiple, conflicting objectives.
sentences.zh: 进一步将 GFlowNets 扩展到多目标设置已引起越来越多的关注，因为真实世界的应用往往涉及多个相互冲突的目标。

sentences.en: However, existing approaches require joint training for each combination of objectives, meaning that any change in the objective set necessitates retraining from scratch.
sentences.zh: 然而，现有方法需要对每种目标组合进行联合训练，这意味着目标集合的任何变化都需要从头重新训练。

sentences.en: We propose a framework that composes pre-trained GFlowNets at inference time, enabling rapid adaptation without fine-tuning or retraining.
sentences.zh: 我们提出了一个在推断阶段组合预训练 GFlowNet 的框架，能够无需微调或重训即可快速适配。

sentences.en: Importantly, our framework is flexible, capable of handling diverse reward combinations ranging from linear scalarization to complex nonlinear operators, which are often handled separately in previous literature.
sentences.zh: 重要的是，我们的框架十分灵活，能够处理从线性标量化到复杂非线性算子的多种奖励组合，而这些在以往文献中通常是分开处理的。

sentences.en: We prove that our method exactly recovers the target distribution for linear scalarization, and quantify the approximation quality for nonlinear operators through a distortion factor.
sentences.zh: 我们证明，我们的方法能够精确恢复线性标量化情况下的目标分布，并通过一个失真因子来量化非线性算子的近似质量。

sentences.en: Experiments on a synthetic 2D grid and real-world molecule generation tasks demonstrate that our approach achieves performance comparable to baselines.
sentences.zh: 在合成二维网格与真实世界的分子生成任务上的实验表明，我们的方法取得了与基线相当的性能。

sentences.en: The code is available at https://github.com/ml-postech/gflownet-composition.
sentences.zh: 代码可在 https://github.com/ml-postech/gflownet-composition 获取。

title_en: Row-Stochastic Matrices Can Provably Outperform Doubly Stochastic Matrices in Decentralized Learning
title_zh: 行随机矩阵可在分散式学习中可证明地优于双随机矩阵

sentences.en: Decentralized learning often involves a weighted global loss with heterogeneous node weights $\lambda$.
sentences.zh: 分散式学习通常涉及一个具有非均匀节点权重 $\lambda$ 的加权全局损失。

sentences.en: We revisit two natural strategies for incorporating these weights: (i) embedding them into the local losses to retain a uniform weight (and thus a doubly stochastic matrix), and (ii) keeping the original losses while employing a $\lambda$-induced row-stochastic matrix.
sentences.zh: 我们重新审视了纳入这些权重的两种自然策略：(i) 将权重嵌入到局部损失中以保持均匀权重（因而使用双随机矩阵），(ii) 保留原始损失，同时使用由 $\lambda$ 诱导的行随机矩阵。

sentences.en: Although prior work shows that both strategies target the same $\lambda$-weighted global loss, it remains unclear whether the Euclidean-space guarantees are tight and what fundamentally differentiates their behaviors.
sentences.zh: 尽管先前的工作表明这两种策略都针对相同的 $\lambda$ 加权全局损失，但欧几里得空间中的保证是否紧致，以及何种因素从根本上区分了它们的行为，仍不清楚。

sentences.en: To clarify this, we develop a weighted Hilbert-space framework $L^2(\lambda;\mathbb{R}^d)$ and obtain convergence rates that are strictly tighter than those from standard Euclidean analysis.
sentences.zh: 为澄清这一点，我们发展了一个加权的 Hilbert 空间框架 $L^2(\lambda;\mathbb{R}^d)$，并获得了比标准欧几里得分析严格更紧的收敛速率。

sentences.en: In this geometry, the row-stochastic matrix becomes *self-adjoint* whereas the doubly stochastic one does not, creating additional *penalty terms* that amplify consensus error, thereby slowing convergence.
sentences.zh: 在该几何中，行随机矩阵是*自伴的（self-adjoint）*，而双随机矩阵则不然，这就产生了额外会放大一致性误差的*罚项（penalty terms）*，从而拖慢收敛。

sentences.en: Consequently, the difference in convergence arises not only from spectral gaps but also from these penalty terms.
sentences.zh: 因此，收敛性的差异不仅源于谱间隙，还源于这些罚项。

sentences.en: We then derive sufficient conditions under which the row-stochastic design converges faster even with a smaller spectral gap.
sentences.zh: 随后，我们推导了行随机设计即便在谱间隙较小的情况下也能更快收敛的充分条件。

sentences.en: Finally, by using a Rayleigh-quotient and Loewner-order eigenvalue comparison, we further obtain topology conditions that guarantee this advantage and yield practical topology-design guidelines.
sentences.zh: 最后，通过使用 Rayleigh 商与 Loewner 序特征值比较，我们进一步获得了能够保证这一优势的拓扑条件，并给出了实用的拓扑设计指南。

title_en: RQ-MoE: Residual Quantization via Mixture of Experts for Efficient Input-Dependent Vector Compression
title_zh: RQ-MoE：通过专家混合实现残差量化，用于高效的输入相关向量压缩

sentences.en: Vector quantization is a fundamental tool for compressing high-dimensional embeddings, yet existing multi-codebook methods rely on static codebooks that limit expressiveness under heterogeneous data geometry.
sentences.zh: 向量量化是压缩高维嵌入的基础工具，然而现有的多码本方法依赖于静态码本，在异构的数据几何下限制了表现力。

sentences.en: While recent dynamic quantizers like QINCo adapt codebooks to individual inputs and improve expressiveness, their strict sequential dependencies create decoding bottlenecks.
sentences.zh: 虽然 QINCo 等近期的动态量化器能够使码本适配单个输入并提升表现力，但它们严格的顺序依赖造成了解码瓶颈。

sentences.en: We propose Residual Quantization via Mixture of Experts (RQ-MoE), a framework combining a two-level MoE with dual-stream quantization to enable input-dependent codebook adaptation for efficient vector quantization.
sentences.zh: 我们提出了通过专家混合实现残差量化（Residual Quantization via Mixture of Experts, RQ-MoE），一种将两级 MoE 与双流量化相结合的框架，以实现输入相关的码本适配，从而进行高效的向量量化。

sentences.en: RQ-MoE enables dynamic codebook construction and decouples instruction from quantization, facilitating parallel decoding.
sentences.zh: RQ-MoE 支持动态码本构建，并将指令与量化解耦，从而有利于并行解码。

sentences.en: Theoretically, we show that standard Residual Quantization and QINCo can be recovered as constrained special cases of RQ-MoE, and derive a guideline for setting expert dimensionality in RQ-MoE. Extensive experiments show that RQ-MoE achieves state-of-the-art or on-par performance in reconstruction and retrieval, while it can provide 6×–14× faster decoding than prior vector quantization methods.
sentences.zh: 理论上，我们表明标准的残差量化与 QINCo 可以被视为 RQ-MoE 的受约束特例，并推导出在 RQ-MoE 中设置专家维度的准则。大量实验表明，RQ-MoE 在重建与检索方面取得了最先进或相当的性能，同时相比以往的向量量化方法能够提供 6×–14× 的更快速解码。

sentences.en: The implementation is available at https://github.com/KDEGroup/RQ-MoE.
sentences.zh: 实现可在 https://github.com/KDEGroup/RQ-MoE 获取。

title_en: RSA-CP: Efficient Conformal Prediction in Small-Sample Regimes via Random Score Alignment
title_zh: RSA-CP：通过随机分数对齐在小样本场景中实现高效共形预测

sentences.en: Conformal Prediction (CP) provides rigorous finite-sample coverage guarantees, yet its statistical efficiency hinges critically on the size of the calibration set.
sentences.zh: 共形预测（Conformal Prediction, CP）提供严格的有限样本覆盖保证，然而其统计效率关键地取决于校准集的大小。

sentences.en: In data-scarce regimes, CP often suffers from volatile quantile estimation, leading to overly conservative and wide prediction intervals.
sentences.zh: 在数据稀缺的场景中，CP 往往遭受分位数估计不稳定的困扰，导致预测区间过于保守而宽泛。

sentences.en: To address this, we propose Random Score Alignment-Conformal Prediction (RSA-CP), a simple framework designed to improve sample efficiency in small-sample CP.
sentences.zh: 为解决这一问题，我们提出了随机分数对齐共形预测（Random Score Alignment-Conformal Prediction, RSA-CP），一个旨在改进小样本 CP 样本效率的简单框架。

sentences.en: Instead of requiring the computationally intensive generation of full synthetic datasets, RSA-CP enhances calibration by directly aligning real scores with a high-resolution reference score distribution.
sentences.zh: RSA-CP 无需生成完整合成数据集这一计算密集的过程，而是通过直接将真实分数与高分辨率参考分数分布对齐来增强校准。

sentences.en: By employing an optimal transport mapping, our framework refines "step-like" quantile increments through a globally optimal use of reference information.
sentences.zh: 通过采用最优传输映射，我们的框架以参考信息的全局最优利用方式，精化了“阶梯状”的分位数增量。

sentences.en: We provide theoretical guarantees establishing that RSA-CP maintains robust coverage without any distributional assumptions on the reference scores.
sentences.zh: 我们提供了理论保证，确立了 RSA-CP 在不依赖参考分数任何分布假设的情况下维持稳健覆盖。

sentences.en: Empirical evaluations demonstrate that RSA-CP consistently produces shorter and more precise prediction intervals while maintaining finite-sample coverage guarantees.
sentences.zh: 实证评估表明，RSA-CP 在维持有限样本覆盖保证的同时，一致地产生更短且更精确的预测区间。

sentences.en: Overall, RSA-CP offers a computationally efficient and theoretically grounded solution for robust uncertainty quantification under limited data.
sentences.zh: 总体而言，RSA-CP 为在有限数据下进行鲁棒的不确定性量化，提供了一种计算高效且具有理论基础的解决方案。

title_en: RSAgent: Learning to Reason and Act via Multi-Turn Tool Invocations for Text-Guided Segmentation
title_zh: RSAgent：通过多轮工具调用学习推理与行动以进行文本引导分割

sentences.en: Text-guided object segmentation requires both cross-modal reasoning and pixel grounding abilities.
sentences.zh: 文本引导的目标分割既需要跨模态推理能力，也需要像素级定位能力。

sentences.en: Most recent methods treat it as a single forward pass, where the model directly predicts pixel prompts to a segmentation model, which limits verification, refocusing and refinement when initial localization is wrong.
sentences.zh: 大多数近期方法将其视为单次前向传播，即模型直接向分割模型预测像素提示，当初始定位错误时，这限制了验证、重新聚焦与精化。

sentences.en: To address this limitation, we propose **RSAgent**, an agentic Multimodal Large Language Model (MLLM) which interleaves **reasoning and action** for segmentation via multi-turn tool invocations.
sentences.zh: 为克服这一局限，我们提出了**RSAgent**，一种智能体式的多模态大语言模型（MLLM），它通过多轮工具调用，将分割所需的**推理与行动**交错进行。

sentences.en: RSAgent queries a visual toolbox, observes feedback, and revises its pixel hypothesis using historical observations to re-localize targets and iteratively refine masks.
sentences.zh: RSAgent 查询视觉工具箱，观察反馈，并利用历史观察修正其像素假设，从而重新定位目标并迭代式地精化掩码。

sentences.en: We further build a data pipeline to synthesize multi-turn reasoning segmentation trajectories, and train RSAgent with a two-stage framework: cold-start supervised fine-tuning followed by agentic reinforcement learning with fine-grained, task-specific rewards.
sentences.zh: 我们进一步构建了一条数据流水线来合成多轮推理分割轨迹，并通过两阶段框架训练 RSAgent：冷启动监督微调，随后进行带有细粒度、任务特化奖励的智能体式强化学习。

sentences.en: Extensive experiments show that RSAgent achieves a zero-shot performance of 66.5% gIoU on ReasonSeg test, improving over Seg-Zero-7B by 9%, and reaches 81.5% cIoU on RefCOCOg, demonstrating state-of-the-art performance on both in-domain and out-of-domain benchmarks.
sentences.zh: 大量实验表明，RSAgent 在 ReasonSeg 测试集上取得了 66.5% gIoU 的零样本性能，相比 Seg-Zero-7B 提升了 9%，并在 RefCOCOg 上达到 81.5% cIoU，在域内与域外基准上都展示了最先进的性能。

title_en: RSF-GLLM: Bridging the Semantic Gap in Multi-Hop Knowledge Graph QA via Recurrent Soft-Flow and Decoupled LLM Generation
title_zh: RSF-GLLM：通过循环软流与解耦的 LLM 生成弥合多跳知识图谱 QA 中的语义鸿沟

sentences.en: Multi-hop Question Answering over Knowledge Graphs faces a critical challenge: traditional retrieve-then-read pipelines break differentiability, preventing the retriever from learning to bridge the semantic gap where intermediate nodes lack lexical overlap with the query.
sentences.zh: 知识图谱上的多跳问答面临着关键挑战：传统的检索后阅读流水线破坏了可微性，使检索器无法学习弥合语义鸿沟——即中间节点与查询缺乏词汇重叠的情形。

sentences.en: To address this, we propose RSF-GLLM, a framework decoupling differentiable graph reasoning from answer generation.
sentences.zh: 为解决这一问题，我们提出了 RSF-GLLM，一个将可微的图推理与答案生成相解耦的框架。

sentences.en: Our Recurrent Soft-Flow (RSF) module employs a GRU-guided query updater to propagate continuous relevance scores, utilizing a dynamic gating mechanism to traverse semantically dissimilar bridge nodes via structural cues.
sentences.zh: 我们的循环软流（Recurrent Soft-Flow, RSF）模块采用 GRU 引导的查询更新器来传播连续的关联度分数，利用动态门控机制借助结构线索遍历语义上不相似的桥接节点。

sentences.en: We introduce flow sparsity regularization to theoretically guarantee convergence from soft probabilities to discrete reasoning paths.
sentences.zh: 我们引入了流稀疏正则化，以从理论上保证从软概率到离散推理路径的收敛。

sentences.en: These paths are extracted and textualized to fine-tune a Large Language Model (LLM), ensuring generation is grounded in factual topology.
sentences.zh: 这些路径被提取并以文本形式呈现，用于微调一个大型语言模型（LLM），确保生成基于事实拓扑。

sentences.en: Experiments on WebQSP and CWQ demonstrate that RSF-GLLM achieves competitive performance with superior inference efficiency compared to LLM based computationally expensive approaches.
sentences.zh: 在 WebQSP 与 CWQ 上的实验表明，相比基于 LLM 的计算昂贵的方法，RSF-GLLM 在取得具有竞争力性能的同时，具有更优越的推理效率。

title_en: RSPO: Regularized Self-Play Alignment of Large Language Models
title_zh: RSPO：大语言模型的正则化自博弈对齐

sentences.en: Self-play-based policy optimization has emerged as an effective approach for fine-tuning large language models (LLMs), formulating preference optimization as a two-player game.
sentences.zh: 基于自博弈的策略优化已成为微调大型语言模型（LLM）的有效方法，它将偏好优化表述为一个双人博弈。

sentences.en: However, the regularization with respect to the reference policy, which is crucial for mitigating over-optimization, has been insufficiently investigated in self-play alignment.
sentences.zh: 然而，自博弈对齐中对参考策略的正则化（这对于缓解过度优化至关重要）尚未得到充分研究。

sentences.en: To study the impact of different regularization strategies, we propose \textbf{Regularized Self-Play Policy Optimization (RSPO)}, a novel framework that unifies prior methods and enables simple plug-and-play regularizers, meanwhile preserving convergence to Nash equilibrium of the corresponding regularized game.
sentences.zh: 为研究不同正则化策略的影响，我们提出了\textbf{正则化自博弈策略优化（Regularized Self-Play Policy Optimization, RSPO）}，一个统一了先前方法并支持简单即插即用正则化器的全新框架，同时保持收敛到相应正则化博弈的纳什均衡。

sentences.en: We empirically show that RSPO with appropriate regularizers can substantially improve the length-controlled win rate (LCWR) on AlpacaEval-2 across a range of base models, while also achieving consistently superior performance on Arena-Hard, MT-Bench, ArmoRM, and response diversity.
sentences.zh: 我们实证表明，配备适当正则化器的 RSPO 能够在多种基础模型上显著提升 AlpacaEval-2 的长度控制胜率（LCWR），同时在 Arena-Hard、MT-Bench、ArmoRM 与回答多样性上也取得了一致的优越性能。

sentences.en: In particular, RSPO improves unregularized self-play baseline (SPPO) on AlpacaEval-2 LCWR from $28.5\%$ to $ 35.4\%$ with base model Mistral-7B, from $38.77\%$ to $43.66\%$ with LLaMA-8B, and from $50.54\%$ to $51.83\%$ with Gemma-2B.
sentences.zh: 特别是，在基础模型 Mistral-7B 上，RSPO 将 AlpacaEval-2 LCWR 从不加正则化的自博弈基线（SPPO）的 $28.5\%$ 提升到 $35.4\%$；在 LLaMA-8B 上从 $38.77\%$ 提升到 $43.66\%$；在 Gemma-2B 上从 $50.54\%$ 提升到 $51.83\%$。

sentences.en: Combining simplicity, convergence guarantees, and significant empirical gains, RSPO offers a strong foundation for exploring regularized self-play in alignment.
sentences.zh: 兼具简洁性、收敛保证与显著的实证提升，RSPO 为在对齐中探索正则化自博弈提供了一个坚实的基础。

title_en: RSTR: Reducing SpatioTemporal Redundancy in Diffusion Transformers
title_zh: RSTR：降低扩散 Transformer 中的时空冗余

sentences.en: Diffusion Transformers (DiTs) have achieved remarkable success in image generation, yet their deployment is hindered by high computational costs.
sentences.zh: 扩散 Transformer（DiTs）在图像生成方面取得了显著成功，但其部署受到高计算成本的阻碍。

sentences.en: We identify two sources of redundancy.
sentences.zh: 我们识别出两个冗余来源。

sentences.en: First, $\textbf{temporal redundancy}$: Classifier-Free Guidance (CFG) applies costly dual forward passes at every timestep, yet guidance matters only at specific steps, and variable scales at critical steps can compensate for skipping others.
sentences.zh: 首先，$\textbf{时间冗余（temporal redundancy）}$：无分类器引导（CFG）在每个时间步都会进行代价高昂的双前向传播，然而引导仅在特定步骤才起作用，并且在关键步骤使用可变尺度可以补偿其他步骤的跳过。

sentences.en: Second, $\textbf{spatial redundancy}$: under variable guidance, different transformer blocks exhibit heterogeneous sensitivity, yet uniform calibration across all blocks wastes computation while failing to address their varying requirements.
sentences.zh: 其次，$\textbf{空间冗余（spatial redundancy）}$：在可变引导下，不同的 Transformer 块表现出异质的敏感性，然而对所有块进行统一校准既浪费计算，又无法满足它们各异的需求。

sentences.en: We present RSTR, the first framework to jointly reduce spatiotemporal redundancy in diffusion transformers.
sentences.zh: 我们提出了 RSTR，这是第一个联合降低扩散 Transformer 中时空冗余的框架。

sentences.en: Stage-1 addresses temporal redundancy through evolutionary search, discovering sparse guidance schedules with variable scales.
sentences.zh: 第一阶段通过进化搜索来处理时间冗余，发现具有可变尺度的稀疏引导调度。

sentences.en: Stage-2 addresses spatial redundancy through adaptive rank allocation, assigning calibration capacities to transformer regions based on their sensitivity.
sentences.zh: 第二阶段通过自适应秩分配来处理空间冗余，根据 Transformer 各区域的敏感性为其分配校准容量。

sentences.en: Experiments on DiT-XL/2, PixArt-$\alpha$, FLUX, and state-of-the-art Qwen-Image demonstrate 50\%-70\% compute savings while maintaining or improving quality.
sentences.zh: 在 DiT-XL/2、PixArt-$\alpha$、FLUX 以及最先进的 Qwen-Image 上的实验表明，可以节省 50\%-70\% 的计算量，同时保持或提升质量。

sentences.en: On DiT-XL/2, RSTR achieves 57\% savings with 15\% FID improvement; on Qwen-Image, 3.43$\times$ speedup with preserved quality.
sentences.zh: 在 DiT-XL/2 上，RSTR 实现了 57\% 的节省并带来 15\% 的 FID 改善；在 Qwen-Image 上，则在保持质量的同时实现了 3.43$\times$ 的加速。

title_en: RT-Lynx: Putting the GEMM Sparsity In a Right Way for Diffusion Models
title_zh: RT-Lynx：以正确的方式为扩散模型引入 GEMM 稀疏性

sentences.en: Diffusion Transformers (DiT) achieve strong performance in image generation but incur substantial inference costs.
sentences.zh: 扩散 Transformer（DiT）在图像生成方面取得了强劲的性能，但会带来可观的推理成本。

sentences.en: While prior work has reduced this cost via quantization and distillation, semi-structured sparsity—which can nearly halve FLOPs—remains underexplored.
sentences.zh: 虽然先前的工作通过量化与蒸馏降低了这一成本，但半结构化稀疏——它几乎可以将 FLOPs 减半——仍未被充分探索。

sentences.en: A key reason is that most existing approaches focus on weight sparsification, and pruning 50\% of the weights can remove critical model capacity and degrade generation quality.
sentences.zh: 一个关键原因是，大多数现有方法都专注于权重稀疏化，而剪枝 50\% 的权重可能会移除关键的模型容量，从而降低生成质量。

sentences.en: Our study, however, shows that DiT activations are intrinsically sparse and significantly more robust to N:M semi-structured sparsification than weights.
sentences.zh: 然而，我们的研究表明，DiT 的激活在本质上是稀疏的，并且对 N:M 半结构化稀疏化的鲁棒性远高于权重。

sentences.en: Motivated by this observation, we advocate a paradigm shift from weight sparsification to activation sparsification.
sentences.zh: 受这一观察的启发，我们倡导从权重稀疏化到激活稀疏化的范式转变。

sentences.en: We propose RT-Lynx, which applies N:M sparsification to activations and incorporates error-compensation techniques to mitigate accuracy loss.
sentences.zh: 我们提出了 RT-Lynx，它对激活应用 N:M 稀疏化，并结合误差补偿技术来缓解准确率损失。

sentences.en: We further implement highly optimized CUDA kernels tailored to this setting, achieving up to a 1.55× speedup on average in linear layers.
sentences.zh: 我们进一步实现了针对该设置定制的高度优化的 CUDA 内核，在线性层中平均可实现高达 1.55× 的加速。

sentences.en: Extensive experiments across multiple diffusion models demonstrate that our method preserves the generation quality of the original models while substantially accelerating inference.
sentences.zh: 跨多个扩散模型的大量实验表明，我们的方法在保持原始模型生成质量的同时显著加速了推理。

title_en: RTInfer: Real-Time Inference of Multiple DNNs on Edge GPUs
title_zh: RTInfer：边缘 GPU 上多个 DNN 的实时推理

sentences.en: While edge GPUs are increasingly used for latency-critical DNN tasks, limited resources often fail to meet strict real-time (RT) requirements under concurrent workloads.
sentences.zh: 虽然边缘 GPU 越来越多地用于时延关键型的 DNN 任务，但在并发工作负载下，有限的资源往往无法满足严格的实时（RT）要求。

sentences.en: Existing preemption and early-exit mechanisms often underutilize GPU resources through single-task queuing and sacrifice excessive accuracy during task bursts.
sentences.zh: 现有的抢占与提前退出机制往往通过单任务排队使 GPU 资源利用不足，并在任务突发期间牺牲过多的准确率。

sentences.en: To address this, we propose RTInfer, a novel system that enables concurrent RT task execution while balancing throughput and accuracy.
sentences.zh: 为解决这一问题，我们提出了 RTInfer，一个能够在兼顾吞吐量与准确率的同时实现并发 RT 任务执行的新颖系统。

sentences.en: RTInfer integrates an accuracy-calibrated lightweight variant co-optimization to generate efficient models, a memory-layout-aware scheduler to mitigate fragmentation during preemption, and an on-demand loading strategy to minimize host-to-GPU latency.
sentences.zh: RTInfer 集成了准确率校准的轻量级变体协同优化以生成高效的模型、一个内存布局感知的调度器以缓解抢占期间的碎片化，以及一种按需加载策略以使主机到 GPU 的延迟最小化。

sentences.en: Extensive evaluations demonstrate that RTInfer outperforms state-of-the-art methods by reducing average deadline miss rate (DMR) from 32.8\% to 0\% and improving accuracy by up to 56.5\%.
sentences.zh: 广泛的评估表明，RTInfer 优于最先进的方法，将平均截止时间错失率（DMR）从 32.8\% 降低到 0\%，并将准确率提升高达 56.5\%。

title_en: RTPrune: Reading-Twice Inspired Token Pruning for Efficient DeepSeek-OCR Inference
title_zh: RTPrune：受两次阅读启发的 token 剪枝，用于高效的 DeepSeek-OCR 推理

sentences.en: DeepSeek-OCR leverages visual–text compression to reduce long-text processing costs and accelerate inference, yet visual tokens remain prone to redundant textual and structural information.
sentences.zh: DeepSeek-OCR 利用视觉-文本压缩来降低长文本处理成本并加速推理，然而视觉 token 仍然容易包含冗余的文本与结构信息。

sentences.en: Moreover, current token pruning methods for conventional vision–language models (VLMs) fail to preserve textual fidelity due to improper compression mechanisms.
sentences.zh: 此外，目前针对常规视觉语言模型（VLM）的 token 剪枝方法，由于不恰当的压缩机制而无法保持文本保真度。

sentences.en: By analyzing the decoding process of DeepSeek-OCR, we find that a distinct two-stage reading trajectory: the model initially prioritizes the majority of high-norm tokens, then subsequently redistributes its attention to the remaining ones.
sentences.zh: 通过分析 DeepSeek-OCR 的解码过程，我们发现存在一条独特的两阶段阅读轨迹：模型最初倾向于处理绝大多数具有高范数的 token，随后将其注意力重新分配给剩余的 token。

sentences.en: Motivated by this insight, we propose *RTPrune*, a two-stage token pruning method tailored for DeepSeek-OCR.
sentences.zh: 受这一洞察启发，我们提出了*RTPrune*，一种专为 DeepSeek-OCR 定制的两阶段 token 剪枝方法。

sentences.en: In the first stage, we prioritize high-norm visual tokens that capture salient textual and structural information.
sentences.zh: 在第一阶段，我们优先处理能够捕获显著文本与结构信息的高范数视觉 token。

sentences.en: In the second stage, the remaining tokens are paired and merged based on optimal transport theory to achieve efficient feature aggregation.
sentences.zh: 在第二阶段，剩余的 token 基于最优传输理论进行配对与合并，以实现高效的特征聚合。

sentences.en: We further introduce a dynamic pruning ratio that adapts to token similarity and textual density for OCR tasks, enabling a better efficiency–accuracy trade-off.
sentences.zh: 我们进一步引入了一个动态剪枝比率，使其适应 OCR 任务中的 token 相似度与文本密度，从而实现更好的效率-准确率权衡。

sentences.en: Extensive experiments demonstrate state-of-the-art performance, as evidenced by 99.47\% accuracy and 1.23× faster prefill on OmniDocBench, achieved with 84.25\% token retention when applied to DeepSeek-OCR-Large.
sentences.zh: 大量实验展示了最先进的性能，正如在 OmniDocBench 上 99.47\% 的准确率与 1.23× 更快的预填充（prefill）所证明的那样，当应用于 DeepSeek-OCR-Large 时，只需保留 84.25\% 的 token。

sentences.en: Code is released.
sentences.zh: 代码已发布。

title_en: Rubric Curriculum RL: Exploiting the Generation-Verification Gap in Non-Verifiable Domains
title_zh: 评测准则课程强化学习：利用不可验证领域中的生成-验证鸿沟

sentences.en: Reinforcement learning with verifiable rewards (RLVR) on foundation models has led to significant gains in math and code generation.
sentences.zh: 在基础模型上使用可验证奖励的强化学习（reinforcement learning with verifiable rewards, RLVR）已在数学与代码生成方面带来显著增益。

sentences.en: Extending these gains to open-ended domains remains challenging: ground-truth verification is unavailable, human annotation is expensive, and learned reward models are prone to reward hacking.
sentences.zh: 将这些增益扩展到开放式领域仍然具有挑战性：真实标注验证不可用，人工标注成本高昂，而学习得到的奖励模型又容易受到奖励黑客行为的影响。

sentences.en: We introduce Rubric Curriculum RL (RcRL), a general self-improvement method for non-verifiable tasks that requires no new data, human annotations, or stronger teacher models.
sentences.zh: 我们引入了评测准则课程强化学习（Rubric Curriculum RL, RcRL），一种面向不可验证任务的通用自我改进方法，它不需要新数据、人工标注或更强的教师模型。

sentences.en: RcRL exploits the generation-verification gap, where judging good outputs is easier than producing them.
sentences.zh: RcRL 利用了生成-验证鸿沟，即判断好输出比生成它们更容易。

sentences.en: We combine pairwise preferences over rollouts with a curriculum over rubric criteria, yielding a more discriminative signal than absolute scoring while reducing reward hacking through a non-stationary objective.
sentences.zh: 我们将对 rollout 的成对偏好与覆盖评测准则的课程相结合，相比绝对评分产生更具判别力的信号，同时通过非平稳目标减少奖励黑客行为。

sentences.en: Whereas baselines plateau or collapse within a few hundred steps, RcRL preserves output entropy and keeps improving past 1000 steps.
sentences.zh: 当基线方法在数百步内便趋于平稳或崩溃时，RcRL 保持了输出熵，并且在超过 1000 步之后仍在持续改进。

sentences.en: On creative writing, RcRL outputs are preferred 70.5% of the time compared to the base model, with consistent gains across multiple creative writing benchmarks and judges.
sentences.zh: 在创意写作方面，与基础模型相比，RcRL 的输出有 70.5% 的情况下被更偏好，且在多个创意写作基准与评判者上都取得了一致的增益。

sentences.en: On HealthBench, RcRL improves over the base model by 14.6% (full set) and 25.4% (consensus subset), outperforming all HealthBench training baselines, including instance-specific rubrics.
sentences.zh: 在 HealthBench 上，RcRL 相比基础模型提升了 14.6%（完整集）与 25.4%（共识子集），超越了包括实例特化评测准则在内的所有 HealthBench 训练基线。

authors.name: Tejas Krishnan
authors.institution: Department of Computer Science, University of Oxford

title_en: RubricRobustness: Evaluating the Sensitivity of Rubrics-Based Benchmarks to Simple Perturbations
title_zh: RubricRobustness：评估基于评测准则的基准对简单扰动的敏感性

sentences.en: The advancement of Large Language Models (LLMs) into higher-level reasoning domains has rendered traditional heuristic evaluators insufficient for long-form open-ended responses, precipitating the widespread adoption of rubric-based benchmarks.
sentences.zh: 大型语言模型（LLM）向更高层级推理领域的发展，使得传统的启发式评估器不足以应对长篇开放式回答，从而促成了基于评测准则（rubric）的基准的广泛采用。

sentences.en: While these frameworks utilize expert-curated criteria and LLM-as-a-judge to assess open-ended generation, the intrinsic robustness of these evaluation harnesses to fundamental validity assessments remains critically under-investigated.
sentences.zh: 虽然这些框架利用专家精挑细选的标准与“LLM 作为评判者”来评估开放式生成，但这些评估框架对基本有效性评估的内在鲁棒性仍然严重缺乏研究。

sentences.en: To bridge this gap, we introduce RubricRobustness, a systematic sensitivity analysis framework that subjects these benchmarks to three common sense perturbations: *semantic negation*, *stochastic deletion* and *irrelevant addition*.
sentences.zh: 为弥补这一空白，我们引入了 RubricRobustness，一个系统性的敏感性分析框架，它将三种常识性扰动施加到这些基准上：*语义否定（semantic negation）*、*随机删除（stochastic deletion）*与*无关添加（irrelevant addition）*。

sentences.en: We investigate the extent to which manipulating the semantic veracity of a model's response impacts its resulting score by applying the robustness framework to two of the most popular rubrics-based benchmarks: HealthBench and WildBench.
sentences.zh: 我们通过将鲁棒性框架应用于两个最流行的基于评测准则的基准——HealthBench 与 WildBench，考察了操纵模型回答的语义真实性对其最终得分的影响程度。

sentences.en: Our findings reveal systematic vulnerabilities: while both benchmarks respond sharply to semantic negation (e.g., degradation slopes of approximately $-0.38$ on HealthBench and $-0.55$ on WildBench), they are substantially less responsive to irrelevant addition, often requiring over 35% of sentences to be perturbed before inducing even a 25% score drop.
sentences.zh: 我们的发现揭示了系统性的脆弱性：虽然两个基准对语义否定的反应都很强烈（例如，在 HealthBench 上约 $-0.38$、在 WildBench 上约 $-0.55$ 的退化斜率），但它们对无关添加的反应要弱得多，通常需要超过 35\% 的句子被扰动，才会诱发哪怕是 25\% 的得分下降。

sentences.en: We argue that perturbation-based sensitivity analyses of this form are a necessary prerequisite for validating rubric coverage, ensuring that automated evaluation frameworks reliably penalize basic semantic failures.
sentences.zh: 我们认为，这种基于扰动的敏感性分析是验证评测准则覆盖度的必要前提，它确保自动化评估框架能够可靠地惩罚基本的语义失败。

sentences.en: We will release our framework as an open-source tool for building more resilient benchmarks.
sentences.zh: 我们将把我们的框架作为开源工具发布，用于构建更具韧性的基准。

title_en: RuCL: Stratified Rubric-Based Curriculum Learning for Multimodal Large Language Model Reasoning
title_zh: RuCL：面向多模态大语言模型推理的分层评测准则课程学习

sentences.en: Reinforcement Learning with Verifiable Rewards (RLVR) has emerged as a prevailing paradigm for enhancing reasoning in Multimodal Large Language Models (MLLMs).
sentences.zh: 可验证奖励强化学习（Reinforcement Learning with Verifiable Rewards, RLVR）已成为增强多模态大语言模型（MLLM）推理能力的主流范式。

sentences.en: However, relying solely on outcome supervision risks reward hacking, where models learn spurious reasoning patterns to satisfy final answer checks.
sentences.zh: 然而，仅依赖结果监督存在奖励黑客的风险，即模型会学习虚假的推理模式来满足最终答案的检查。

sentences.en: While recent rubric-based approaches offer fine-grained supervision signals, they suffer from high computational costs of instance-level generation and inefficient training dynamics caused by treating all rubrics as equally learnable.
sentences.zh: 虽然近期的基于评测准则的方法提供了细粒度的监督信号，但它们却受困于实例级生成的高计算成本，以及因将所有评测准则视为同等可学而导致的无效率训练动态。

sentences.en: In this paper, we propose **Stratified Rubric-based Curriculum Learning (RuCL)**, a novel framework that reformulates curriculum learning by shifting the focus from data selection to reward design.
sentences.zh: 在本文中，我们提出了**分层评测准则课程学习（Stratified Rubric-based Curriculum Learning, RuCL）**，一个通过将关注点从数据选择转向奖励设计来重新表述课程学习的新颖框架。

sentences.en: RuCL generates generalized rubrics for broad applicability and stratifies them based on model competence, dynamically adjusting their weights to guide the model from foundational perception to advanced logical reasoning.
sentences.zh: RuCL 生成具有广泛适用性的通用评测准则，并依据模型能力对它们进行分层，动态调整其权重，以引导模型从基础感知走向高级逻辑推理。

sentences.en: Extensive experiments on various visual reasoning benchmarks show that RuCL yields a remarkable **+7.83%** average improvement over the Qwen2.5-VL-7B model, achieving a state-of-the-art accuracy of **60.06%**.
sentences.zh: 在多种视觉推理基准上的大量实验表明，RuCL 在 Qwen2.5-VL-7B 模型基础上取得了显著的**+7.83%**平均提升，达到了**60.06%**的最先进准确率。

title_en: Rule2DRC: Benchmarking LLM Agents for DRC Script Synthesis with Execution-Guided Test Generation
title_zh: Rule2DRC：以执行引导的测试生成来对 DRC 脚本合成的 LLM 智能体进行基准测试

sentences.en: Manufacturable chip layouts must satisfy thousands of geometry-based design rules, and design rule checking (DRC) enforces them by running executable DRC scripts on layouts.
sentences.zh: 可制造的芯片版图必须满足数千条基于几何的设计规则，而设计规则检查（DRC）通过在版图上运行可执行的 DRC 脚本来强制执行这些规则。

sentences.en: Translating natural language rules into correct DRC scripts is labor-intensive and requires specialized expertise, motivating LLM agents for DRC script synthesis and debugging.
sentences.zh: 将自然语言规则翻译为正确的 DRC 脚本劳动密集且需要专业知识，这促使人们使用 LLM 智能体来进行 DRC 脚本的合成与调试。

sentences.en: However, existing benchmarks have small evaluation sets and often evaluate scripts by code similarity rather than execution correctness, and prior machine learning-based methods either ignore execution feedback or require labeled test layouts as agent's input.
sentences.zh: 然而，现有基准的评测集规模较小，而且往往通过代码相似度而非执行正确性来评估脚本；此外，先前基于机器学习的方法要么忽略执行反馈，要么需要带有标注的测试版图作为智能体的输入。

sentences.en: To this end, we introduce Rule2DRC, a large-scale benchmark for DRC script coding agents with 1,000 rule-to-script tasks and 13,921 evaluation chip layouts for execution-based scoring.
sentences.zh: 为此，我们引入了 Rule2DRC，一个面向 DRC 脚本编码智能体的大规模基准，包含 1,000 个规则到脚本的任务以及 13,921 个用于基于执行打分的评测芯片版图。

sentences.en: Rule2DRC provides an evaluation pipeline that measures functional correctness via DRC execution outcomes without requiring evaluation layouts as input to the agent.
sentences.zh: Rule2DRC 提供了一条评测流水线，它通过 DRC 执行结果来衡量功能正确性，而无需将评测版图作为智能体的输入。

sentences.en: We also propose SplitTester, a tester agent for program selection that uses execution feedback to generate discriminative test cases and separate previously indistinguishable candidate scripts, substantially improving Best-of-N selection performance in this domain.
sentences.zh: 我们还提出了 SplitTester，一个用于程序选择的测试器智能体，它利用执行反馈生成具有判别力的测试用例，将此前无法区分的候选脚本分离开来，从而在该领域显著提升了 Best-of-N 选择性能。

sentences.en: We release the code at https://github.com/snu-mllab/Rule2DRC.
sentences.zh: 我们在 https://github.com/snu-mllab/Rule2DRC 发布了代码。

title_en: RulePlanner: All-in-One Reinforcement Learner for Unifying Design Rules in 3D Floorplanning
title_zh: RulePlanner：用于统一三维版图规划中设计规则的一体化强化学习器

sentences.en: Floorplanning determines the coordinate and shape of each module in Integrated Circuit.
sentences.zh: 版图规划决定了集成电路中每个模块的坐标与形状。

sentences.en: With the advancement of technology node, in floorplanning stage especially 3D scenarios with multiple stacked layers, it has become increasingly challenging to adhere to complex hardware design rules.
sentences.zh: 随着工艺节点的进步，在版图规划阶段（尤其是包含多层堆叠的三维场景）中，遵循复杂的硬件设计规则变得越来越具有挑战性。

sentences.en: Current methods are only capable of handling specific and limited design rules, while violations of other rules require manual and meticulous adjustment.
sentences.zh: 当前方法仅能处理特定且有限的设计规则，而违反其他规则的情况则需要人工细致的调整。

sentences.en: This leads to labor-intensive and time-consuming post-processing for expert engineers.
sentences.zh: 这导致专家工程师进行劳动密集且耗时的后处理。

sentences.en: In this paper, we propose an all-in-one deep reinforcement learning-based approach to tackle these challenges, and design novel representations for real-world IC design rules that have not been addressed by previous approaches.
sentences.zh: 在本文中，我们提出了一种基于深度强化学习的一体化方法来应对这些挑战，并为先前方法未曾解决的真实世界 IC 设计规则设计了新颖的表示形式。

sentences.en: Specifically, the processing of various hardware design rules is unified into a single framework with three key components: 1) novel matrix representations to model the design rules, 2) constraints on the action space to filter out invalid actions that cause rule violations, and 3) quantitative analysis of constraint satisfaction as reward signals.
sentences.zh: 具体而言，各种硬件设计规则的处理被统一到包含三个关键组件的单一框架中：1) 用于对设计规则建模的新颖矩阵表示；2) 对动作空间施加约束，以滤除会导致规则违反的无效动作；3) 将约束满足的定量分析作为奖励信号。

sentences.en: Experiments on public benchmarks demonstrate the effectiveness and validity of our approach.
sentences.zh: 在公开基准上的实验证明了我们方法的有效性与合理性。

sentences.en: Furthermore, transferability are well shown on unseen circuits.
sentences.zh: 此外，在未见电路上的可迁移性也得到了充分展示。

sentences.en: Our framework is extensible to accommodate new design rules, thus providing flexibility to address emerging challenges in future chip design.
sentences.zh: 我们的框架具有可扩展性，能够容纳新的设计规则，从而为应对未来芯片设计中涌现的挑战提供了灵活性。

title_en: RVAS: Referring Video Active Exploration and Segmentation
title_zh: RVAS：指代视频主动探索与分割

sentences.en: Existing referring video object segmentation (RVOS) is largely built on passive perception and assumes the target is already visible in the observed video, which limits real-world use when queries refer to objects beyond the current view.
sentences.zh: 现有的指代视频目标分割（referring video object segmentation, RVOS）大多建立在被动感知之上，并假设目标在观测到的视频中已经可见，这限制了其在查询所指对象超出当前视野时的真实世界应用。

sentences.en: To address this gap, we introduce Referring Video Active Exploration and Segmentation (RVAS), a new task that focuses on reasoning about exploration policy and then locating and segmenting the object according to an input referring expression.
sentences.zh: 为弥合这一空白，我们引入了指代视频主动探索与分割（Referring Video Active Exploration and Segmentation, RVAS），这是一个新任务，侧重于推理探索策略，然后依据输入指代表达式定位并分割目标。

sentences.en: To support RVAS, we build a large-scale dataset with manually annotated exploration actions and reference reasoning traces, enabling supervised training and evaluation.
sentences.zh: 为支持 RVAS，我们构建了一个包含人工标注的探索动作与指代推理轨迹的大规模数据集，从而支持监督训练与评估。

sentences.en: We benchmark representative RVOS and related video understanding baselines and find that they struggle to perform active target search and incur substantial overhead when coupled with online decision making.
sentences.zh: 我们对有代表性的 RVOS 及相关视频理解基线进行了基准测试，发现它们难以进行主动的目标搜索，并且在与在线决策结合时会产生可观的额外开销。

sentences.en: Motivated by these challenges, we propose LESA, a baseline framework that introduces a state controller and hierarchical memory for efficient streaming processing and sparse MLLM reasoning.
sentences.zh: 受这些挑战的启发，我们提出了 LESA，一个引入状态控制器与分层记忆的基线框架，用于高效的流式处理与稀疏的 MLLM 推理。

sentences.en: LESA substantially reduces inference cost while maintaining competitive planning quality, and consistently improves segmentation accuracy on the RVAS dataset.
sentences.zh: LESA 在保持有竞争力的规划质量的同时大幅降低了推理成本，并在 RVAS 数据集上持续提升了分割准确率。

sentences.en: Code is available at [https://github.com/FudanCVL/RVAS](https://github.com/FudanCVL/RVAS).
sentences.zh: 代码可在 [https://github.com/FudanCVL/RVAS](https://github.com/FudanCVL/RVAS) 获取。

title_en: Rényi Diffusion Models
title_zh: Rényi 扩散模型

sentences.en: The choice of training objective is central to diffusion-based generative modeling in terms of both sample quality and distribution coverage.
sentences.zh: 在扩散式生成建模中，训练目标的选择无论对样本质量还是分布覆盖都至关重要。

sentences.en: While standard maximum likelihood training provides a principled objective with strong theoretical grounding, empirical studies indicate that previous training objectives in diffusion models often face an inverse correlation between likelihood optimization and perceptual evaluations.
sentences.zh: 虽然标准的最大似然训练提供了一种具有坚实理论基础的原理性目标，但实证研究表明，扩散模型中先前的训练目标往往面临似然优化与感知评估之间的反向相关。

sentences.en: We propose the Rényi diffusion model, a unified generative framework that formulates training objectives using Rényi divergence.
sentences.zh: 我们提出了 Rényi 扩散模型，一个使用 Rényi 散度来表述训练目标的统一生成框架。

sentences.en: This yields a generalized score matching objective providing explicit control over the trade-off between sample quality and distribution coverage.
sentences.zh: 这产生了一个广义的分数匹配目标，能够显式地控制样本质量与分布覆盖之间的权衡。

sentences.en: Experiments demonstrate improved balance between density estimation and sample generation performances across multiple datasets without modifying model architectures or sampling procedures.
sentences.zh: 实验表明，在无需修改模型架构或采样流程的情况下，该方法在多个数据集上改善了密度估计与样本生成性能之间的平衡。

title_en: S$^3$GNN: Efficient Global Mixing and Local Message Passing for Long-Range Graph Learning
title_zh: S$^3$GNN：面向长程图学习的高效全局混合与局部消息传递

sentences.en: Message-passing neural networks (MPNNs) often suffer from an information bottleneck when capturing long-range dependencies, leading to the oversquashing (OSQ) phenomenon.
sentences.zh: 消息传递神经网络（MPNN）在捕获长程依赖时往往遭受信息瓶颈，从而引发过度压缩（oversquashing, OSQ）现象。

sentences.en: Alongside spatial connectivity enrichment (e.g., rewiring), recent studies have shown that spectral filtering can yield strong long-range learning outcomes, as spectral operators enable global information mixing that alleviates OSQ.
sentences.zh: 除了空间连通性增强（如重新布线）之外，近期的研究表明谱滤波能够带来强大的长程学习效果，因为谱算子实现了能够缓解 OSQ 的全局信息混合。

sentences.en: These approaches achieve this either by stabilizing the Jacobian energies in deep propagation or by guaranteeing OSQ mitigation under strong theoretical assumptions.
sentences.zh: 这些方法要么通过稳定深度传播中的雅可比能量来实现这一点，要么在强理论假设下保证缓解 OSQ。

sentences.en: We revisit these conclusions and show that the associated Jacobian sensitivity lower bound is generally difficult to achieve in practice.
sentences.zh: 我们重新审视了这些结论，并表明相关的雅可比敏感度下界在实践中通常很难达到。

sentences.en: We then propose S$^3$GNN, which mitigates OSQ without such restrictive assumptions by lightweightly reintroducing omitted components with substantially lower computational complexity, while standard stability constraints on feature transformations remain effective under our new dynamics.
sentences.zh: 随后我们提出了 S$^3$GNN，它以远低于原来的计算复杂度轻量级地重新引入被省略的组件，从而在没有这些限制性假设的情况下缓解 OSQ，同时标准特征变换的稳定性约束在我们的新动力学下仍然有效。

sentences.en: Extensive experiments across diverse domains (e.g., long-range benchmarks, KGQA, and mesh-based fluid dynamics) demonstrate that S$^3$GNN achieves up to an order-of-magnitude error reduction with up to 50\% fewer parameters.
sentences.zh: 跨多个不同领域（如长程基准、KGQA 与基于网格的流体动力学）的大量实验表明，S$^3$GNN 在参数最多减少 50\% 的情况下，实现了高达一个数量级的误差降低。

sentences.en: Our code can be found in https://anonymous.4open.science/r/S3GNN-2359.
sentences.zh: 我们的代码可在 https://anonymous.4open.science/r/S3GNN-2359 找到。

title_en: S-Quant: Rethinking Weight Quantization with Seed-Based Generation
title_zh: S-Quant：用基于种子的生成重新思考权重量化

sentences.en: The progressive scaling of large language models (LLMs) has consistently enhanced multimodal understanding and advanced reasoning capabilities, but has substantially increased computational and hardware execution overhead.
sentences.zh: 大型语言模型（LLM）的不断扩展持续增强了多模态理解与高级推理能力，但也大幅增加了计算与硬件执行开销。

sentences.en: In this paper, we present S-Quant, a novel post-method that compresses only model weights.
sentences.zh: 在本文中，我们提出了 S-Quant，一种仅压缩模型权重的全新后处理方法。

sentences.en: We partition each weight tensor into fixed-size blocks and assign a single seed to each block.
sentences.zh: 我们将每个权重张量划分为固定大小的块，并为每个块分配一个种子。

sentences.en: The seed drives a hardware-friendly Linear Feedback Shift Register (LFSR) generator that dynamically produces multiple basis matrices.
sentences.zh: 该种子驱动一个硬件友好的线性反馈移位寄存器（LFSR）生成器，动态地产生多个基矩阵。

sentences.en: Each block is then reconstructed as a linear combination of these basis matrices, with block-specific coefficients, which substantially reduces the amount of stored data, increases the data-transfer efficiency between memory and compute units, and consequently speeds up memory-bound inference for large language models.
sentences.zh: 随后，每个块被重建为这些基矩阵的线性组合，并配有块级特定的系数，这大幅减少了存储的数据量，提升了内存与计算单元之间的数据传输效率，从而加速了大语言模型的内存受限推理。

sentences.en: Experimental results on different LLM models ranging from 7B–70B parameters show that S-Quant attains state-of-the-art performance when weights are compressed to approximately 3-bit or 4-bit.
sentences.zh: 在 7B–70B 参数范围的不同 LLM 模型上的实验结果表明，当权重被压缩到约 3 位或 4 位时，S-Quant 取得了最先进的性能。

sentences.en: We also design a dedicated ASIC accelerator that achieves a 4× speed-up for memory-bound LLM inference.
sentences.zh: 我们还设计了一个专用的 ASIC 加速器，为内存受限的 LLM 推理实现了 4× 的加速。

title_en: S2GS: Streaming Semantic Gaussian Splatting for Online Scene Understanding and Reconstruction
title_zh: S2GS：用于在线场景理解与重建的流式语义高斯泼溅

sentences.en: Existing offline feed-forward methods for joint scene understanding and reconstruction on long image streams often perform global computation over an ever-growing set of past observations, causing runtime and GPU memory to increase rapidly with sequence length.
sentences.zh: 针对长图像序列上联合场景理解与重建的现有离线前馈方法，往往会对不断增长的过去观测集合进行全局计算，导致运行时间与 GPU 内存随序列长度迅速增加。

sentences.en: We propose Streaming Semantic Gaussian Splatting (S2GS), a strictly causal and incremental framework that builds a 3D Gaussian semantic field from image streams without accessing future frames or reprocessing historical observations.
sentences.zh: 我们提出了流式语义高斯泼溅（Streaming Semantic Gaussian Splatting, S2GS），一个严格因果且增量式的框架，它能够在不访问未来帧或重新处理历史观测的情况下，从图像序列构建三维高斯语义场。

sentences.en: S2GS continuously updates scene geometry, appearance, and instance-level semantics through a geometry--semantic decoupled dual-backbone design.
sentences.zh: S2GS 通过几何-语义解耦的双主干设计，持续更新场景几何、外观与实例级语义。

sentences.en: The geometry branch performs causal modeling for incremental Gaussian updates, while the semantic branch leverages a 2D foundation vision model and a query-driven decoder to predict masks and identity embeddings.
sentences.zh: 几何分支执行因果建模以进行增量式高斯更新，而语义分支则利用二维基础视觉模型与查询驱动的解码器来预测掩码与身份嵌入。

sentences.en: Query-level contrastive alignment and lightweight online association with an instance memory further stabilize temporal identities.
sentences.zh: 查询级对比对齐以及与实例记忆的轻量级在线关联，进一步稳定了时序身份。

sentences.en: Experiments show that S2GS matches or outperforms strong offline baselines, while substantially improving long-horizon scalability: it processes over 1,000 frames with much slower runtime and GPU memory growth, whereas offline global-processing baselines typically run out of memory at around 80 frames under the same setting.
sentences.zh: 实验表明，S2GS 与强大的离线基线相比相当甚至更优，同时大幅提升了长视界可扩展性：它能够处理超过 1,000 帧的图像，且运行时间与 GPU 内存增长更慢，而在相同设置下，离线的全局处理基线通常在约 80 帧时就会耗尽内存。

sentences.en: Project Page: https://stdcoutzrh.github.io/projects/s2gs/.
sentences.zh: 项目主页：https://stdcoutzrh.github.io/projects/s2gs/。
